messages.subject: Krka HR | Director-Level External Affairs, ESG & Government Relations Executive
messages.body:
Dear Krka Human Resources Team,

I am reaching out regarding senior international opportunities where external affairs, government and regulatory relations, ESG, stakeholder strategy and strategic partnerships intersect.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder engagement, compliance coordination and executive communications for a major multinational operation.

Across 12+ years, I have also worked in regulated financial services and commercial operations. My strongest contribution is in leadership roles where public institutions, regulatory complexity, sustainability, reputation and business execution must be managed together.

I am pursuing Director, Senior Director, Head and VP-track mandates across Corporate Affairs, External Affairs, Government Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships and Country Leadership. I am internationally mobile and open to relocation.

I have attached a Krka-tailored executive CV for review and future matching. I would value consideration for relevant current or upcoming international leadership opportunities, or referral to the appropriate senior HR colleague.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
